tool_call_format: <|tool_call>call:NAME{key:value,...}<tool_call|> with <|tool_response>response:NAME{value:...}<tool_response|>; strings are wrapped in <|"|> markers, tool definitions go in a <|tool>...<tool|> block inside the first system turn
notes: enable_thinking defaults to false. True adds <|think|> to the first system turn and leaves the model turn open; false (or absent) closes an empty <|channel>thought\n<channel|> at the generation prompt. The template never reads reasoning_effort or thinking, so every effort value renders byte-identically to the plain prompt: llama.cpp's b11960 caps will report supports_reasoning_effort=false and reasoning_effort_levels=[]. A developer message in position 0 is rendered as the system turn, identical to role system. Parallel tool calls render as consecutive <|tool_call> blocks followed by consecutive <|tool_response> blocks.
